title: Engine setup: Remote-Only vs Local+Remote choice pre-step, plus a welcome-modal UI refresh
description:
Fabio, 2026-08-10: the first-run ComfyUI setup modal (MpiEngineInstall, setup phase) should not open on a models-folder picker. It should open on a CHOICE of two cards - 'Remote Only' (connect a RunPod account, no local engine) and 'Local + Remote' (install ComfyUI on this machine). The existing RunPod escape hatch at the bottom of the setup phase becomes that first card and stops being a footnote link.

Second half: the current welcome/setup screen is visually weak (two stacked h2s, one of which literally reads 'Welcome', a left-aligned form inside a centred column, an underlined-link escape hatch). Both screens get a design pass with the impeccable skill against the Stage baseline in styles/01_base.css.

Both must be reviewable in the dev component gallery. The install and upgrade modals are already mounted there (js/pages/components.js preview-engine-install-install / -upgrade, slots in templates/tpl-components.html); the choice screen needs its own entry.

BEHAVIOUR IS ALREADY BUILT, DO NOT REINVENT IT. 'Remote Only' is exactly what the MPI-390 hatch does: set state.runpodConfig = { ...state.runpodConfig, enabled: true, skipLocalEngine: true } then Events.emit('engine:install-skipped'). 'Local + Remote' just reveals the existing setup phase. Do NOT auto-open Settings on the remote path - that races the first-launch 18+/changelog overlay chain (MPI-333).

Scope note: the choice pre-step is for mode 'installing' only. 'upgrading' and 'repairing' mean an engine already exists and must go straight to the progress phase as they do today.
